name: freeq-lite
intent: Write a small chat server in Go that speaks a subset of IRC, like a simplified freeq: nicknames, channels, channel and private messages, ping, and quit.
contract: It is a single Go program, standard library only. It is started as `<binary> -addr <host:port>` and must listen for TCP connections on that address; the server's name in replies is `freeq-lite`.
